name: repair_bad_step_ref
prompt: This playbook ran on the box and reported success, but the FortiGate step blocked nothing -- the run log shows `ip_addresses` arrived empty. Find the defect and return the corrected complete YAML. Change nothing else.
notes: The troubleshoot verb, which had zero coverage: select_diagnose_failure only graded that the agent REACHED why_did_playbook_fail, never whether the diagnosis was right. Defect is the corpus's most common authoring mistake -- a Jinja reference to the step's YAML id (`analyst_ip_action`) instead of the underscore-joined display name (`Analyst_IP_Action`). Both gates are load-bearing: deleting the reference or the step clears the diagnostic and passes `verified`, and only `no_collateral_damage` says the playbook was gutted.

ir_assertions.note: the block reads the analyst's IP through the DISPLAY-name path
the block step is still there
the gate still precedes the block -- a fix must not reroute it
